capabilities: Place notes into gojūon folders based on a normalized reading property
Move a note automatically when its reading property changes
Update internal links via Obsidian's file manager while notes move
Preview the inbox with movable, unresolved, and collision counts before moving
Migrate existing collections by adding reading properties and planning gojūon moves
extras: Ships with a standalone Python migration CLI (standard library only) that runs outside Obsidian; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README repeatedly warns to back up the vault before automatic or bulk file moves.
problem: Large vocabulary vaults become slow to browse when many notes share one folder, and kanji filenames cannot be sorted by pronunciation without explicit reading metadata.
summary: Files Japanese vocabulary notes into gojūon folders derived from a reading property, updating links automatically, with a dry-run-first migration CLI.
